_comment: How the cars drive in the scripts (see docs/modding.md, scripts). A feel is a kind and its numbers; a number left out
is its kind's, as below. Speeds in metres a second, accelerations in metres a second squared, times in seconds.
road: along a path, cruising between bends, slow enough in them (cornerAccel), braking in time for a stop.
launch: hard off the line through the gears along a path to its end. pull: gently away in first gear, steering
for a point (the lot). roll_in: rolling in and braking to a stop, the braking fading as it stops (the garage).

feels._comment: The gas station: about 30 mph on the road, the gears changed up as it goes
A rival coming up the street: about 27 mph in second, braking to a stop alongside
A rival leaving: hard off the line, a little less in each gear, never past what a street car does
Out of a bay in the lot: to a walking pace and a bit in first gear, turning for the way out
Into the garage: in at 5 m/s, the braking fading to nothing at the stop
